effect:
Boosts Normal-type moves by 20%. (Hold)

Silk Scarf powers up Normal-type moves, which is more useful than it sounds. Normal-type coverage moves like Return, Body Slam, or Facade get a solid boost from this item.

Since Normal-type isn't super effective against anything, the 20% boost helps compensate. Good for in-game Normal-types or Pokémon running Facade with status orb strategies!
